title: System design from first principles to design review
intro: Build a parking reservation service on paper and on the JVM. Estimate a concert peak, race for the last space, lose a payment reply and recover after a bad release. Transfer your reasoning to tickets, feeds and private uploads.
how: Predict each result before stepping through the diagram. Try the exercises on paper first. The local service lab uses JDK 21 and Python 3. Finish with a design review that changes one assumption.
